description: Estimate how much the user receives for sending an amount, with the minimum and maximum for the pair. Network fees are already taken out of estimatedAmount. The rate floats, so the result is an estimate, not a promise. Show any warnings to the user.

amount.description: Amount of the from currency, as a decimal like "0.05".

from.description: Currency to send. Currency id from search_currencies, for example btc, eth or usdttrc20.

to.description: Currency to receive. Currency id from search_currencies, for example btc, eth or usdttrc20.

name: get_quote
title: Get a swap quote
